responsibility: Groups the baked locale-fallback data exposed by this crate, serving as the namespace that collects likely-subtags data, parent-locale fallback data, and fallback supplement data for the generated provider macros.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the leaf `mod.rs` files under `likelysubtags_v1`, `parents_v1`, and `supplement/co_v1` that hold concrete payload lookups, this `mod.rs` is only an intermediate namespace wiring together the fallback subtree by declaring its child modules.
